paragraphs: The “Arts & Entertainment” category is a top-level department in Shopify’s product taxonomy. It brings together the product families assigned to Arts & Entertainment, providing the starting point for classification throughout this branch of the catalog. Its immediate branches include Event Tickets, Hobbies & Creative Arts, Party & Celebration.

Choose Arts & Entertainment when the product’s primary purpose fits this classification path. Compare its position with adjacent categories under Arts & Entertainment before assigning a product, using the product’s actual function rather than a promotional name. Where an immediate branch describes the product more precisely, follow that branch and continue to the most appropriate specific category.

The “Event Tickets” category belongs to Arts & Entertainment. It groups items under the official Shopify classification “Arts & Entertainment > Event Tickets”, keeping this product family distinct within its parent, Arts & Entertainment. This is a terminal category in this release, so it provides the most specific available placement along this classification path.

When describing products in Event Tickets, useful Shopify classification details include Event country: Identifies the country where the event takes place; Event day of week: Identifies the day of the week on which the event takes place; Event language: Identifies the language used for the event's spoken or presented content; Event type: Classifies the nature of an event, such as a concert, seminar, or festival. These are descriptive comparison points rather than required GitStore category fields; retain the product’s actual characteristics when choosing a category. Use this placement for products that fit the named category; products serving a different purpose should be classified in the appropriate neighboring branch.
